_doc: Per-phase, per-bench assertions for v5 certification (Migration doctrine 5).
_why: Phase 0 certified with 'Assertions: none declared' on both benches. That means certification proved only 'nothing drifted' — which a phase that built nothing would also pass. Drift-absence is a necessary condition, not a sufficient one. These assertions are the sufficient half: what must be TRUE for the phase to have actually happened.
_contract: A phase MUST have an entry here before it can certify. phase_certify.py refuses to run for an undeclared phase rather than defaulting to zero assertions — a silent empty list is how Phase 0 certified without them.

_bench_semantics.brownfield: mywheel itself. Asserts the phase's artefacts EXIST and its oracles pass — this is where 'did we build it' is checked.
_bench_semantics.greenfield: a spoke that has never seen v4 or v5. Asserts the first-run experience is intact. Most phase artefacts live in managed/, which a fresh spoke does not receive until distribution (Ruling 14: distribution happens once, at the end), so greenfield asserts what a NEW USER sees, not what we built.

_renumber_map._doc: old phase id -> new phase id, applied 2026-08-07 by impl-v5-renumber-phases-once-cleanly-v1. See docs/wheelwright-v5-control-plane-directive.md Part V.
